name: tokenguard
description: Lives in VS Code chat, estimates tokens, enforces a token budget, and highlights token-economics mistakes as you chat with AI.

chatParticipants.name: tokenguard
chatParticipants.description: Guards your token budget and flags token-economics mistakes before the model runs.

commands.title: TokenGuard: Show Edit ROI (did the edits stick?)

tokenguard.sessionBudget.description: Maximum input+output tokens allowed per session before TokenGuard blocks requests.

tokenguard.dailyBudget.description: Maximum input+output tokens allowed per calendar day before TokenGuard blocks requests.

tokenguard.warnThresholdPercent.description: Percentage of a budget at which TokenGuard starts warning (before hard block at 100%).

tokenguard.hardBlock.description: If true, requests over budget are refused. If false, TokenGuard warns but still runs the request.

tokenguard.maxAttachedReferences.description: Warn when more than this many files/context references are attached to a single request.

tokenguard.snowballGrowthTokens.description: Warn when a turn's context grows by more than this many tokens versus the previous turn in the same session.

tokenguard.cheapModelHints.description: Substrings that identify a cheap/small model. Used to detect 'overkill model for a trivial task'.

tokenguard.sensitivePatterns.description: Optional user-supplied regex patterns (JavaScript syntax) that flag sensitive data pasted into a prompt. When empty, a built-in set of generic secret detectors is used. Add your own organization-specific identifiers here in your user settings.

tokenguard.modelPrices.description: Override or add per-model prices (USD per 1,000,000 tokens). Keys are lowercase substrings matched against the model id; each value is { "input": number, "output": number }. Example: { "my-model": { "input": 1.0, "output": 4.0 } }

tokenguard.reasoningModelHints.description: Substrings that identify a reasoning model whose hidden thinking tokens are billed as output.

tokenguard.assumedCacheReadFraction.description: OPT-IN estimate: fraction (0–1) of input tokens assumed to be prompt-cache reads. Copilot does not expose the real cache split, so 0 (default) reports list-price upper-bound cost. Set e.g. 0.9 if most of your input is cached context.

tokenguard.cacheReadPriceMultiplier.description: Price of a cached input token as a fraction of the normal input rate (providers typically charge ~0.1×). Only used when tokenguard.assumedCacheReadFraction > 0.

tokenguard.reasoningOutputMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to output tokens on reasoning models to approximate hidden thinking-token cost.

tokenguard.maxToolResultChars.description: Maximum characters of a tool result fed back to the model. Larger results are truncated to curb the context snowball.

tokenguard.blockDuplicates.description: Skip re-running a request that closely matches an earlier one this session, to save tokens.

tokenguard.duplicateSimilarityThreshold.description: Similarity (0..1) above which a request is treated as a duplicate of an earlier one this session.

tokenguard.enableCompaction.description: Summarise older tool results when history exceeds the context window, to defuse the context snowball.

tokenguard.maxContextWindowTokens.description: Approximate token ceiling for accumulated history before TokenGuard compacts older tool results.

tokenguard.maxToolsPerRequest.description: Maximum tools sent per request. TokenGuard keeps its own tools plus the most relevant external tools up to this budget.

tokenguard.usageLogEnabled.description: Append per-turn usage records (OpenTelemetry GenAI attributes) to .tokenguard/usage.jsonl for ingestion by an observability pipeline.

tokenguard.creditMultipliers.description: Override estimated Copilot premium-request credit multipliers per model. Keys are lowercase substrings matched against the model id; values are credits per request. Example: { "opus": 10, "gpt-4o": 1 }
